headline: Maryville win at Drury as Lincoln play on unbeaten
dek: Maryville won at Drury on Friday, on the ground where the two had drawn in October, and have lost four times all season. They travel to Saginaw Valley State today, the same day Lincoln, still without a defeat, meet Roosevelt.
displaced_by: Lincoln meet Roosevelt today, so the standing headline's finished season and the dek's 'last match of the season' are no longer true; Maryville's win at Drury on Friday takes the lede.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist have scored forty-five goals, more than either Lincoln or Drury near the top, but they have conceded thirty-six and lost seven times; the leaders have built their place at the other end of the pitch.

wire.line: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference still without a defeat this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have lost five times this season: at home to Oklahoma Christian in August, away at Missouri S&T in September, at home to Lincoln and to Missouri-St. Louis in October, and at home to Maryville in November.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jonathan Nemorden, a freshman, has twelve of Lincoln's forty-two goals, from sixty-nine shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jacob Panagos, a midfielder, has fifteen of Truman's twenty-eight goals, from fifty-seven shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made seventy-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty-five, a save percentage of .693.

last_match.line: Drury have not won since beating Southwest Baptist in October.

next_match.line: Lincoln have won every match they played at home this season; Roosevelt won at Missouri-St. Louis in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
